! Based on the pull of 2026-10-10 14:02 by alice over ssh (18 minutes ago; the login could see
! secrets) and the standard of 2026-10-10 14:20 (tacctl 0.2.5). Lab-tested on IOS 12.4(15) (a 7200
! emulator); other IOS trains and IOS-XE are written from the references.
!
! What is irregular on dev-cisco-real-12-4-7200 (4 items; the paste fixes 4, leaves 0):
!  1. aaa      ACCESS     missing: the console's own login list CONSOLE (local only, so a local user
!                         always gets in there) (aaa authentication login CONSOLE local). Fixed by
!                         region line 3.
!  2. aaa      ACCESS     missing: the 'enable' list (it asks the server first, so nobody needs a
!                         shared enable password) (aaa authentication enable default group LAB-TACACS
!                         enable). Fixed by region line 4.
!  3. aaa      ACCESS     different: the login method of line con 0: login authentication CONSOLE (the
!                         device has: the login method of line con 0: login authentication default)
!                         (line con 0 > login authentication CONSOLE). Fixed by region line 10.
!  4. roles    COSMETIC   missing: the commands of privilege level 7: 2 statements (e.g. privilege
!                         exec all level 7 monitor capture). Fixed by region lines 6-7.
! Consistent: snmp, mgmt-acl. Not planned: netconf, breakglass.
! Secrets: 2 present on the device, not changed (--secrets pushes them).
! Note: privilege exec all level 7 monitor capture: not on the device, which holds 'privilege exec
! level 7 monitor' instead, as an image that does not know 'capture' stores it; a device that lost the
! line looks the same, so it stays missing.
! WARNING: the device has no enable secret: with the server unreachable, level 15 is reached only
! through the local user and 'aaa authorization exec'; set an enable secret first if you want a second
! way.
! The change is live when the paste ends. NOTHING rolls it back by itself. Keep a second terminal
! logged in at privilege 15 until the end.
! Paste over ssh, not the console; on a console paste at most twenty lines at a time and watch the
! echo for '% Invalid'. Pasting the region twice is harmless.
!
! Type this first, on dev-cisco-real-12-4-7200, and check the name:   show version | include uptime
! The prompt must end in # (privileged mode), not in (config)#, before you paste: a prompt ending in >
! means type enable first, a prompt with (config) in it means a configuration session is open: type
! end first.
!
!!!!! PASTE FROM HERE: dev-cisco-real-12-4-7200 !!!!!
configure terminal
! aaa: the method lists tacctl renders, each replaced by the rendered line (the console's own list is local only)
aaa authentication login CONSOLE local
aaa authentication enable default group LAB-TACACS enable
! roles: the privilege lines of the levels tacctl renders
privilege exec all level 7 monitor capture
privilege exec level 7 clear mac address-table dynamic
! aaa: the login method of the console and vty lines
line con 0
 login authentication CONSOLE
end
!!!!! PASTE TO HERE: dev-cisco-real-12-4-7200 !!!!!
!
! If any line printed "% Invalid" or "% Error", stop and undo it: tacctl device config plan
! dev-cisco-real-12-4-7200 --backout (its own region, to paste in the second terminal).

! Check now (nothing rolls this back by itself):
!   From the tacctl server:   tacctl device config pull dev-cisco-real-12-4-7200 --diff     (aaa and roles: ok)
!   In the second terminal:   open a NEW ssh session to dev-cisco-real-12-4-7200 as yourself, then: terminal length 0, show privilege (must say 15)
! When both checks are fine, type this one command yourself:  write memory

! To undo: tacctl device config plan dev-cisco-real-12-4-7200 --backout
